rationale: C18 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both messages begin by acknowledging progress during the past year, frame the subject as an unfinished “battle,” explain why continued work remains necessary despite that progress, and close by urging sustained public participation toward eventual prevention or elimination. This combination of shared language and parallel argumentative sequence is more distinctive and material than a generic appeal for support. C04 has a secondary parallel in its child-welfare appeal, continued need, and confidence in public support; C25 is relevant as a contemporary fundraising appeal expressly including polio organizations, but its administrative campaign machinery and language are less similar.

shared_material.child_excerpt: THE PAST YEAR has been an historic one in the battle against poliomyelitis. We now have a new and important weapon... But the fight against polio is not yet won.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the progress made in fire prevention during the past year... our battle against fire and fire hazards has only begun.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive shared progression: past-year progress, a battle metaphor, and an immediate qualification that the struggle remains unfinished.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Help must continue... There is need for further research, for expanded professional knowledge, for continued care and rehabilitation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: not to consider your work completed... continue to play an active role... We must carry forward the program of education
shared_material.explanation: Both pivot from acknowledged progress to a compact catalogue of work that must continue.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that the American people... will help to meet these needs and hasten the arrival of the day when polio will be virtually eliminated
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Only by these means can we hope to achieve the full objectives adopted at the conference last May.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by linking continued collective effort to eventual achievement of the prevention campaign's ultimate objective.
